title: M12 — Break/fix 01: a Certificate that won't issue
description: config-api is stuck ContainerCreating and its Certificate reads Ready: False. The issuerRef names an issuer that doesn't exist, so cert-manager never signs it, the kubernetes.io/tls Secret is never written, and the Pod that mounts it can't start. Climb the issuance ladder — Certificate then CertificateRequest — and repoint issuerRef at the real internal-CA issuer.
